latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Subtitle Generator Free Extension — rapidly auto-generates and embeds subtitles into videos via a cloud backend.

- Upload video files and describe desired results to generate and burn in subtitles automatically (no manual timeline editing required)
- Automatic setup with free token retrieval (100 credits, 7-day expiry) for new users
- Fast, cloud-based processing: 30–60 seconds for short (<5 min) clips
- Supports common formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac), up to 500MB videos
- Handles basic operations: credits check, file upload, project state, and 1080p MP4 export
- Error handling with guidance for file types, exceeded size, out-of-credits, and more
